_source: Figma get_variable_defs on node 2007:7332 (Components Library), file WJoO8ONNwOiSGN9pbxBSyr, read 2026-10-19. Values marked 'fallback' come from the brief, 'added' are code-side additions agreed with the designer. Keys starting with '_' are ignored by scripts/build-tokens.mjs.

_notes_color.surface/raised: added — Figma uses plain #FFFFFF for cards, panels and the Live timebar.
_notes_color.accent/strong: added — AA-safe accent for text and filled buttons with white text (5.4:1 on white, 4.6:1 on bg/deep).
_notes_color.mode/forecast-strong: added — AA-safe forecast for text and fills with white text (5.2:1 with white, 4.9:1 on bg/forecast).
_notes_color.data/*: rain = accent ramp, snow = #47DAFF ramp, both read from the Layer Card gradients (not variables in Figma).
_notes_color.added (UX review D5): accent/on-dark = links on the dark tooltip (7.9:1 on text/primary); data/snow-strong = snow marker; data/temp* = warm ramp without orange/red; map/edge = map letterbox.

_notes_radius: Brief fallback was sm 8 · md 14 · lg 22 · pill 999. Figma components actually use 10 (chips, cards, panels, timebar) and 20 (layer items, speed chips, Now). Code follows Figma: md 10, lg 20. Logged in DESIGN_QA.md. xs 2 = Data Map Label (ValueLabel) corner, read from the screenshots.
_notes_size: Control heights (UX review D1/A1). sm 24 = small toggles and badges (speed, Back to live, mode badge, toast actions) — WCAG 2.5.8 minimum; md 32 = day chips, player, zoom, locate; lg 40 = rail buttons; xl 44 = search and alerts.
_notes_fontSize: Scale read from Figma text styles. Minimum 11px (brief): the Readout scale labels are 8px in Figma and are raised to xs (11px).
_notes_stroke: Timebar top stripe: Figma 5px, brief 3px — brief wins.
_notes_shadow: Three elevation levels (UX review D3): sm = small things on the map (labels, pin label, slider thumb), md = panels, cards, timebar, pill, toast, lg = reserved for overlays. The pin uses a drop-shadow filter (shape) — the only exception.
_notes_fontWeight: 400 regular, 500 medium (controls), 600 semibold (titles), 700 bold only for display numbers and the logo. Mono only for uppercase labels, coordinates-like tabular data (value labels, badges, time interval).
